newsitem.title: USA: Warburg group lifts VitalCom stake.
newsitem.headline: Warburg group lifts VitalCom stake.

text.p: A group led by E.M. Warburg Pincus & Co Inc said Wednesday it raised its stake in VitalCom Inc to 47.9 percent, from 46.1 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 140,000 additional shares of VitalCom between November 6 and December 3 at pr9icesr anging from $5.25 to $5.50 a share.
The group said it now holds 3,782,264 common shares, which it acquired as an investment.

It said its representative, Elizabeth Weatherman, will continue to serve on the VitalCom board. It added it expects to limit its involvement in the management of the company to representation on the board.
Based in Tustin , Calif., VitalCom provides communications networks that acquire, interpret and distribute real-time clinical data.
